title: Fountainhead Antique Auto Museum

services.name: Museum Rental
services.desc: Let the Fountainhead Antique Auto Museum be the backdrop for your next reception or special event. We offer a dramatic setting for events of all kinds, from car shows and conferences to parties, reunions, group retreats and more. We have the ability to cater for up to 400 guests. The museum’s 30,000 square feet of displays, historic photographs, and vintage clothing exhibits is the perfect backdrop for a singular event. Seasonally, events can utilize our large outdoor tent so your party isn’t limited indoors.
